# Error codes and states

[Lire en français](errors.fr.md)

Every refusal of the local API is JSON: `{ "error": "<message>", "code": "<code>", … }`. **Match on `code`**: it is stable; `error` is a message for people (in French for now) and may change. A `429` carries `Retry-After` (seconds).

For the steps to follow by symptom, see [troubleshooting.md](../troubleshooting.md).

- [Codes of the local API](#codes-of-the-local-api)
- [Codes passed on from Filarr](#codes-passed-on-from-filarr)
- [Why a database is not served](#why-a-database-is-not-served)
- [The link with Filarr](#the-link-with-filarr)
- [What Filarr answers the gate](#what-filarr-answers-the-gate)
- [States of an external sync](#states-of-an-external-sync)

## Codes of the local API

Codes the gate itself returns to your software (and, marked "Admin", its management API).

| code | status | what happened | what to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aborted` | 499 | Library only: `openGate()` was cancelled through its `signal`. | Nothing to fix; open again when you need it. |
| `bad_body` | 400 | The JSON body is not what the route expects: an object for one row, an array of objects for several, never an empty array. | Send `{ "field": value, … }`, or `[{ … }, { … }]` to create several rows at once. |
| `bad_cursor` | 400 | `cursor` is not a value the gate gave out. | Pass the `next` of the previous page exactly as received. |
| `bad_filter` | 400 | A query parameter is neither `field=value` nor `field[op]=value`, or the operator is unknown. In the management API, also a webhook condition that does not parse. | Use one of `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte`, `contains`, `in`, `empty`. Reserved parameters are `limit`, `cursor`, `fields`, `sort`, `q` and `since`. |
| `bad_ip` | 400 | Admin: an allowed address of an app key is neither an IP address nor a CIDR range. | Write `203.0.113.7` or `10.0.4.0/24`. |
| `bad_json` | 400 | The body is not valid JSON. | Check the quoting, and send `Content-Type: application/json`. |
| `bad_limit` | 400 | `limit` is not a whole number of at least 1. | Pass a number from 1 to 1000 (a larger number is served as 1000). |
| `bad_multipart` | 400 | The `multipart/form-data` body of a file deposit cannot be read. | Let your HTTP library build the multipart body (with a `file` part); do not set the boundary by hand. |
| `bad_package` | 400 | The file given to `filarr-gate import` (or `init --import`) is not a Filarr Gate settings package. | Use the file written by `filarr-gate export`, unchanged. |
| `bad_password` | 401 | Admin: the management password is wrong. | Type it again. After 5 failures in a minute the gate answers `too_many_attempts` for a minute. |
| `bad_path` | 400 | The URL path cannot be decoded, or the `path` requested for a file is longer than 1024 characters. | Percent-encode the path segments; shorten the requested path. |
| `bad_request` | 400 | Admin: the management API refused the request (the message says why). | Read `error`, correct the field it names, and try again. |
| `bad_response` | 502 | Filarr accepted a file deposit without returning its identifier. | Try again; if it persists, run `filarr-gate doctor` and report it. |
| `bad_since` | 400 | `since` is not a version number. | Pass the `version` of a page you already read (`since=1042` or `since=v1042`). |
| `bad_tags` | 400 | More than 10 tags, or a tag longer than 40 characters, on a file deposit. | Send 10 tags at most, 40 characters each. |
| `bad_value` | 400 | A value does not fit the column it is written to (a text for a number, a malformed date…). `field` names the field. | Send the JSON type the field expects; `GET /openapi.json` lists each field with its type. |
| `base_not_found` | 404 | No database opened to this access has this slug. | Check the address: `GET /openapi.json`, or the **Databases and endpoints** screen of the management UI, lists the slugs. |
| `base_read_only` | 403 | Filarr opened this database to the access for reading only (right `r`). | In Filarr, open the database to the access in read and write. |
| `body_too_large` | 413 | The body is larger than the gate accepts (4 MiB for JSON; 8 KiB for a wake-up). | Send fewer rows per request (500 at most), or split the work. |
| `box_full` | 409 | The deposit box linked to the access already holds as many deposits waiting to be filed as Filarr allows. Nothing was sent. | Open Filarr on a device that files the box (desktop or web), or file the waiting deposits by hand. Waiting does not help: someone must open Filarr. |
| `box_not_signed` | 409 | The deposit box linked to the access is not signed by the access creator: the gate refuses to seal files for it. | Link the box again from Filarr (desktop or web), which signs it. |
| `confirm_required` | 400 | Admin: forgetting the machine needs the confirmation word. | Type the word the screen asks for. |
| `creator_unauthenticated` | 409 | The gate could not authenticate the access creator's key, so it refuses signed objects (deposit boxes, sync definitions, migrations). Most often the access was created before revision 3 and has no creator tag. | In Filarr (desktop or web), **Settings › API access**, replace the token of this access, then give the new token to the gate. |
| `csrf` | 403 | Admin: a write to the management API without the `X-Gate-Admin: 1` header. | Use the management UI or the `filarr-gate` command; a script must send the header. |
| `deposit_failed` | 500 | The file deposit failed for an unexpected reason (the message says which). | Try again; see the gate's log. |
| `deposit_not_found` | 404 | No deposit of this gate has this identifier. | Use the `id` (`dp_…`) returned by `POST /v1/files`. |
| `field_managed` | 409 | This column is fed by an external source (the sync writes it, `in` direction): the local API does not write it. | Change the value in the source; or, in Filarr, make the column yours (detach it from the sync). |
| `field_read_only` | 400 | This field is computed in Filarr (formula, rollup, creation or update time, back-link) and is never written. | Remove it from the body; write the columns it is computed from. |
| `filarr_unreachable` | 503 | Filarr could not be reached: the write or deposit was NOT done. | Try again later; reads keep being served from the copy meanwhile. |
| `filarr_write_unavailable` | 403 | Filarr does not open writing to this access: the plan has no API writes, or API writes are not switched on yet for the account. | See **Settings › API access** in Filarr, and the plan of the account that created the access. |
| `file_required` | 400 | A multipart deposit without a `file` part. | Name the part `file`, or send the raw bytes with `?name=` (or an `X-File-Name` header). |
| `file_too_large` | 413 | The file is larger than the gate's limit or Filarr's (`limit` gives the size allowed, in bytes). Nothing was sent. | Send a smaller file, or raise `files_max_bytes` (never above the limit Filarr gives). |
| `file_type_refused` | 415 | The gate's filter refused the file before anything left: an extension on the deny list (or missing from the allow list), or an executable signature (`MZ`, ELF, Mach-O, `#!`). `reason` and `detail` say which. | Send a document, not a program; or change `files_deny` / `files_allow` in the gate's settings. |
| `files_not_linked` | 409 | No deposit box is linked to this access, so there is nowhere to deposit files. | In Filarr, link a deposit box to the access (Pro plan and above). |
| `forbidden` | 403 | The app key is valid but is not allowed here: this database, view, query, SQL, MCP, or this kind of write. | Create a key with the endpoints it needs (management UI, **App keys**), or extend this one. |
| `internal` | 500 | An unexpected error inside the gate. | Look at the gate's log; report it with the log line if it repeats. |
| `ip_forbidden` | 403 | The app key only accepts some addresses, and this request comes from another one. | Call from an allowed address, or add yours to the key. Behind a reverse proxy, set `trust_proxy`. |
| `key_expired` | 403 | The app key has expired. | Create a new key; the old one stays refused. |
| `key_missing` | 401 | No app key on the request. | Send `Authorization: Bearer gk_…` (or `X-Gate-Key: gk_…`). |
| `key_missing` | 409 | A write is impossible: the gate does not hold the key of the database's current generation `(e, g)` (it changed, for instance after another access was revoked). `keys` lists what is missing. | The access creator opens Filarr (desktop, web or mobile, unlocked): it re-seals the keys within seconds, and writes resume. |
| `key_not_found` | 404 | Admin: no app key has this identifier. | List the keys (`filarr-gate keys list`) and use one of the identifiers shown. |
| `key_paused` | 403 | The app key is paused. | Resume it in the management UI (**App keys**). |
| `key_rate` | 429 | The app key used up its requests for this minute. `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. | Wait `Retry-After` seconds, or raise the key's rate limit. |
| `key_unknown` | 401 | Unknown or revoked app key. | Check the key; a revoked key never comes back: create a new one. |
| `login_required` | 401 | Admin: the management API needs a session. | Sign in to the management UI, or use `filarr-gate` on the same machine. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | This route does not take this HTTP method (views are read-only; files take `POST` and `GET`). | See the API reference for the methods of each route. |
| `name_required` | 400 | A file deposit without a file name, or a saved query without a name. | Give the file name (with its extension), or a name to the query. |
| `no_token` | 409, 503 | The gate has no token in service (or, at 409, nothing to export or import without one). | Give it the token: `filarr-gate init --token flr_live_…`, the setup screen, or `FILARR_GATE_TOKEN`. |
| `not_found` | 404 | Unknown path, or a feature switched off on this gate (`/metrics`, `/mcp`, `/_filarr/notify`). | Check the path; switch the feature on (`metrics`, `mcp`, `notify` settings). |
| `notify_bad_signature` | 401 | A push wake-up whose signature is not valid for this token (not sent by Filarr for this access). | Nothing to do if it was not Filarr. After replacing the token, the old wake-ups are refused: this is expected. |
| `notify_malformed` | 400, 401 | A push wake-up without a readable `Filarr-Notify` header or body. | Only Filarr calls this route; check what else sends requests to `/_filarr/notify`. |
| `notify_stale` | 401 | A push wake-up signed more than 5 minutes away from this machine's clock. | Set the machine's clock right (NTP); `filarr-gate doctor` shows the gap. |
| `origin_forbidden` | 403 | The request comes from a web page whose origin is not in the CORS list of the gate (CORS is closed by default). | Add the page's origin to `cors_origins` (for example `https://shop.example.com`). Never put a write key in a public page. |
| `other_access` | 400 | `filarr-gate export --for-token` was given the token of ANOTHER access. | Give the new token of the same access (the one Filarr shows when you migrate it). |
| `package_unreadable` | 400 | The settings package was sealed for another token: this gate cannot open it. | Export again with `--for-token` set to THIS gate's token. |
| `password_from_env` | 409 | Admin: the management password comes from `FILARR_GATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` and cannot be changed in the UI. | Change the variable and restart. |
| `query_not_found` | 404 | No saved query has this slug. | The management UI (**SQL explorer**) lists the saved queries and their addresses. |
| `row_not_found` | 404 | No live row has this identifier in this database. | Check the `id`; a row deleted in Filarr is no longer served. |
| `rows_managed` | 409 | The rows of this database come from an external source (mirror, or a natural key): the local API neither creates nor deletes rows here. | Create or delete the row in the source; the next sync pass brings it to Filarr. |
| `same_token` | 400 | `export --for-token` was given this gate's own token. | Give the token of the gate that takes over. |
| `scope_files` | 403 | The app key has no `files` scope: it cannot deposit files. | Create a key with the files scope (`filarr-gate keys create --name … --files`). |
| `scope_required` | 400 | Admin: a new app key must open at least one endpoint (or SQL, or MCP). | Tick at least one endpoint. |
| `settings_refused` | 400 | Admin: a setting could not be changed: it is fixed by an environment variable or `gate.toml`, or the value is invalid (the message says which). | Change it where it is fixed, or correct the value. |
| `setup_code_required` | 403 | Admin: the first setup is done from another machine, which needs the setup code. | Type the 6-digit code that the gate printed in its console at start-up. |
| `setup_done` | 409 | Admin: the first setup is already done. | Sign in with the management password. |
| `source_not_found` | 404 | Admin: no sync definition naming this gate has this identifier. | List them with `filarr-gate sources list`. |
| `sql_empty` | 400 | The SQL query is empty. | Send `{ "sql": "SELECT …" }`. |
| `sql_error` | 400 | The query is valid SQL but cannot run (unknown table or column, wrong function…). `sqlCode` gives the engine's code. | Fix the query; `GET /admin/api/sql/tables` (or the SQL explorer) lists tables and columns. |
| `sql_read_only` | 400 | Only `SELECT` (and `WITH … SELECT`) runs through `/v1/sql`. | Write through `POST`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` on the database's endpoints. |
| `sql_syntax` | 400 | The query does not parse. `position` points at the character where parsing failed. | Fix the syntax (SQLite dialect). |
| `sql_too_long` | 413 | The query is longer than 64 KiB. | Shorten it, or save it as a query and call `/v1/q/<slug>`. |
| `tls_missing` | 400 | Admin: the certificate or key file given for HTTPS does not exist on this machine. | Give paths that exist and that the gate's user can read. |
| `token_from_env` | 409 | Admin: the token comes from `FILARR_GATE_TOKEN` and cannot be replaced in the UI. | Change the variable (or the Worker secret) and restart. |
| `token_refused` | 400 | Admin: Filarr refused the token you entered (unknown, revoked or expired), so it was not kept. | Copy the whole `flr_live_…` token again; if it was replaced or revoked, get a new one from Filarr. |
| `token_required` | 400 | Library only: `openGate()` without a token. | Pass `openGate({ token: process.env.FILARR_GATE_TOKEN })`. |
| `too_many_attempts` | 429 | Admin: 5 wrong passwords in a minute. | Wait a minute. |
| `too_many_rows` | 413 | More than 500 rows in one create request. | Send 500 rows at most per request. |
| `unknown_field` | 400 | A field name is not in this database (in a filter, `sort`, `fields`, or a written body). `field` names it. | Use the JSON field names listed by `GET /openapi.json` (they follow the column names, without accents). |
| `unknown_option` | 400 | A select value is not one of the column's options. | Send one of the option labels (the message lists them); add the option in Filarr first. |
| `view_not_found` | 404 | This database has no view with this slug. | Check the view's slug in `GET /openapi.json`. A view renamed in Filarr keeps its slug. |
| `weak_password` | 400 | Admin: the management password must have 10 characters at least. | Choose a longer one. |
| `webhook_not_found` | 404 | Admin: no webhook has this identifier. | List the webhooks in the management UI. |
| `write_disabled` | 403 | Writing to Filarr is switched off on this gate (the `write` setting, off by default). | Set `FILARR_GATE_WRITE=true` (or `write = true` in `gate.toml`, or the Settings screen), and give the key a write right. |
| `write_failed` | 500 | A write failed for an unexpected reason (the message says which). | Try again; see the gate's log. |

## Codes passed on from Filarr

When Filarr refuses a write or a file deposit, the local API returns Filarr's `code` and status unchanged: `api_rate`, `api_quota_writes`, `api_tier_write`, `api_write_unavailable`, `vault_frozen`, `api_tier_files`, `files_not_switched`, `box_not_permanent`, `box_not_found`, `box_storage_full`, `api_quota_files`, `api_quota_file_bytes`. They are explained [below](#what-filarr-answers-the-gate). Any other refusal of Filarr becomes `502` with Filarr's code.

## Why a database is not served

Until a database is complete and verified, its routes answer `503` with one of these codes. Once it has been served, a later problem does not stop it: the gate keeps serving its last complete copy and adds the header `X-Gate-Base-Status`.

| code | what happened | what to do |
|---|---|---|
| `base_loading` | The gate is still making its first copy of this database. | Wait a few seconds; `GET /health` says when every database is `ready`. |
| `key_missing` | The gate lacks the key of some blocks `(e, g)`: Filarr changed the database's keys and the creator has not re-sealed them for this access yet. The gate never skips a block silently. | The access creator opens Filarr, unlocked: the keys are re-sealed and the gate catches up on its own. |
| `rollback` | The server answered with an older version than the one already read. The gate refuses to go back. | Report it: this should never happen with Filarr's servers. Restarting does not hide it. |
| `head_missing` | Filarr has no head for a version it announced. | Wait for the next change; report it if it persists. |
| `head_unverified` | The database head could not be opened or verified with the keys the gate holds. | See `filarr-gate doctor`; if a key was just changed, the creator opening Filarr re-seals it. |
| `slot_missing` | A block named by the head could not be downloaded. | The gate retries on its own; if it persists, run `filarr-gate doctor`. |
| `slot_unreadable` | A block could not be decrypted. | Report it with the log line; the gate keeps serving its last complete state. |
| `slot_substituted` | A block did not match the fingerprint the head gives for it: someone or something changed it. It is refused. | Report it. The gate never serves a block that fails this check. |
| `unreachable` | Filarr could not be reached while reading this database. | The gate retries; reads keep being served from the last complete copy. |

## The link with Filarr

`GET /health` returns it as `link`; the management UI and `filarr-gate doctor` show it; the library returns it in `status().link`.

| state | what it means | what to do |
|---|---|---|
| `no_token` | No token yet. | Give the gate its token (setup screen, `filarr-gate init`, or `FILARR_GATE_TOKEN`). |
| `connecting` | Starting, or reconnecting after a pause. | Nothing; it moves on by itself. |
| `live` | The live stream of changes is open: a change in Filarr reaches the gate in about a second. | Nothing. |
| `polling` | No live stream (Free plan, the Cloudflare variant, or the stream refused): the gate polls Filarr at the interval of its plan, and on push wake-ups. | Nothing. For faster updates without a stream, give Filarr a wake-up address (`/_filarr/notify`). |
| `offline` | Filarr cannot be reached. The gate keeps serving its last copy and retries with a growing delay. | Check the machine's network and DNS; `filarr-gate doctor` tests Filarr. |
| `limited` | Filarr limits this access (a `429`): the gate waits for `Retry-After` and keeps serving its copy. | See **Usage and limits** (management UI) and the plan's limits in Filarr. |
| `paused` | The access is paused in Filarr. | Reopen it in Filarr, **Settings › API access**. |
| `not_switched` | API access is not open yet for the Filarr account that created the access. | Nothing to do on the gate: it starts as soon as Filarr opens it. |
| `ip_forbidden` | Filarr refuses the IP address of this machine for this access (allowed addresses). | Add the machine's public address to the access in Filarr, or run the gate from an allowed address. |
| `revoked` | The access was revoked, or its token replaced: the gate erased its copy and its keys. | Give the gate a new token (a replaced token: the new one from Filarr). |
| `expired` | The access reached its expiry date: the gate erased its copy. | Create a new access in Filarr, or extend the expiry before it is reached next time. |
| `unknown_access` | Filarr does not know this token (mistyped, or from another Filarr server). | Copy the whole token again; check `FILARR_GATE_API_URL`. |
| `upgrade_required` | This version of Filarr Gate is too old for Filarr's API. | Update Filarr Gate. |
| `pending` | The token is a new identity waiting for a migration: only the access and the settings package answer. | Finish the migration in Filarr ("Erase and change the keys"), or abandon it. |
| `asleep` | A hosted box is asleep (payment, plan or policy). | See **Settings › API access** in Filarr. |
| `error` | Filarr refused something unexpected; `detail` and the log say what. | Run `filarr-gate doctor`. |

## What Filarr answers the gate

The gate handles these by itself; you see them in its log, in `filarr-gate doctor`, and passed on for writes and deposits. Revision 3 codes come with a **remedy** (the vocabulary Filarr's apps use to propose a gesture: `upgrade`, `wait`, `reauthenticate`, `manageBilling`, `updatePayment`).

| code | status | what happened | what the gate does | what to do |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api_access_unknown` | 401 | Filarr does not know this token. | Stops, erases its copy, link `unknown_access`. | Copy the whole token again; check `FILARR_GATE_API_URL`. |
| `api_access_revoked` | 401 | The access was revoked, or its token replaced. | Stops, erases its copy and keys, link `revoked`. | Give the gate a new token. |
| `api_access_expired` | 401 | The access expired. | Stops, erases its copy, link `expired`. | Create a new access, or change the expiry in Filarr before it is reached. |
| `api_access_paused` | 403 | The access is paused in Filarr. | Keeps its copy, serves it, retries; link `paused`. | Reopen the access in Filarr. |
| `api_ip_forbidden` | 403 | This machine's IP address is not allowed for this access. | Link `ip_forbidden`, keeps serving its copy. | Allow the address in Filarr, or call from an allowed one. |
| `store_not_granted` | 403 | The database is not (or no longer) opened to this access, or only for reading when a write was tried. | Re-reads its rights; a write becomes `403 base_read_only`. | Open the database to the access in Filarr (in read and write to write). |
| `api_base_not_switched` | 403 | API access is not open yet for the creator's account. | Link `not_switched`, retries. | Nothing on the gate. |
| `api_tier_stream` | 403 | The plan has no live stream (Free). | Polls instead, never faster than the plan allows. | Nothing; or a plan with live changes. |
| `api_tier_write` | 403 | The plan has no API writes. | Passes the refusal to the application that wrote. | A plan with writes, or read only. |
| `api_write_unavailable` | 403 | API writes are not switched on yet on Filarr's side. | Passes the refusal on. | Nothing on the gate. |
| `api_rate` | 429 | The access sends too many requests per minute to Filarr. | Pauses every exchange with Filarr until `Retry-After`; local reads go on. | Nothing; it resumes. Fewer gates on the same token help. |
| `api_poll_interval` | 429 | Free plan: a database was polled sooner than allowed. | Holds that database until `Retry-After`. | Nothing; the gate never polls faster than `poll_seconds` and the plan. |
| `api_quota_sync` | 429 | The account used up its sync requests for the month. | Holds back that database (head and changes at most every 900 s); local reads go on. | Wait for the next month (UTC), or a higher plan. |
| `api_quota_bytes` | 429 | The account used up its downloaded volume for the month. | Stops downloading blocks until the 1st (UTC); keeps serving what it has. | Wait for the next month, or a higher plan. |
| `api_quota_writes` | 429 | The account used up its accepted writes (commits) for the day. | Refuses the write with `Retry-After` until 00:00 UTC. | Batch rows: one request with 500 rows is one commit. |
| `vault_frozen` | 409 | The vault of this database is frozen (read only). | Refuses the write. | See the vault's state in Filarr. |
| `client_upgrade_required` | 426 | Filarr no longer speaks this version of the protocol. | Link `upgrade_required`. | Update Filarr Gate. |
| `seq_conflict` | 409 | Someone wrote to the database at the same time. | Re-reads the head, re-seals and replays (registers merge): invisible to your software. | Nothing. |
| `stale_generation` | 409 | The database moved to a new generation of keys while the gate was writing. | Re-reads and replays under the new key, if it holds it; otherwise `409 key_missing`. | Nothing, or let the creator open Filarr. |
| `slot_version` | 409 | A block was rewritten meanwhile. | Re-reads and replays. | Nothing. |
| `bad_cover` | 409 | The write's list of blocks no longer matches the head. | Re-reads and replays. | Nothing. |

Revision 3 (hosted box, files, external syncs), read from the vectors:

| code | status | remedy | `Retry-After` | what happened | what to do |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reauth_required` | 401 | `reauthenticate` |  | Entrusting a database to the hosted box needs a fresh proof of identity. | Filarr asks for it on screen (password, two-factor code or passkey). |
| `reauth_failed` | 401 |  |  | The proof of identity was wrong. | Try again; after 10 tries in an hour, wait. |
| `api_tier_hosted` | 403 | `upgrade` |  | The hosted box needs the Pro plan or above. | A higher plan, or run the gate yourself. |
| `hosting_forbidden` | 403 |  |  | The organization forbids hosted boxes. | Ask an organization admin, or run the gate yourself. |
| `hosting_not_switched` | 409 |  |  | The hosted box is not open yet for this account. | Nothing to do; it opens account by account. |
| `consent_outdated` | 409 |  |  | The consent text changed since you accepted it. | Filarr shows the new text again; accept it to keep the database entrusted. |
| `host_key_unknown` | 409 |  |  | Your Filarr app does not know the hosted service's current key. | Update the Filarr app. |
| `hosting_billing_unavailable` | 409 | `manageBilling` |  | No Stripe subscription can carry the option for this payer. | Manage billing in Filarr, or bill the organization. |
| `hosting_exists` | 409 |  |  | This access is already hosted. | Nothing; use the migration screens to change where it runs. |
| `consent_required` | 409 |  |  | Adding a database to a hosted access needs a consent for that database first. | Accept the consent for it in Filarr, then add it. |
| `hosting_not_found` | 404 |  |  | This access is not hosted. | Nothing. |
| `migration_pending` | 409 |  |  | A migration of this access is already in progress. | Finish or abandon it in Filarr. |
| `migration_not_ready` | 409 |  |  | The new gate has not imported its settings package yet. | Start the new gate with its new token and wait for the import, then switch. |
| `hosting_too_large` | 413 |  |  | The databases to entrust are too large for a hosted box. | Entrust fewer databases, or run the gate yourself. |
| `hosting_asleep` | 403 | billing: `updatePayment`; tier: `upgrade`; policy: none; consent: none; service: none |  | The hosted box is asleep (payment, plan or policy). `remedy` says what wakes it up. Gate: Link `asleep`. | See **Settings › API access** in Filarr. |
| `hosted_origin_required` | 401 |  |  | A hosted box's token was presented outside the hosted service. Gate: Refused: a hosted token is useless elsewhere. | Nothing; this protects the token. |
| `receipt_stale` | 409 |  |  | The hosted service handed in an erasure receipt from another hosting of this access, or older than the request it answers. Gate: The hosted box drops it for good. | Nothing. |
| `receipt_unexpected` | 409 |  |  | The hosted service handed in an erasure receipt that the hosting does not wait for (no erasure, or no withdrawal of that database, in progress). Gate: The hosted box drops a full receipt, and retries a partial one later. | Nothing. |
| `api_access_pending` | 403 |  |  | A new identity waiting for a migration called something other than `self` or its import. Gate: Link `pending`; reads its settings package and waits. | Finish the migration in Filarr. |
| `api_tier_files` | 403 | `upgrade` |  | Receiving files through the API needs the Pro plan or above. Gate: Passes the refusal on (`403`). | A higher plan. |
| `files_not_switched` | 409 |  |  | Files through the API are not open yet for this account. Gate: Passes the refusal on. | Nothing; it opens account by account. |
| `files_not_linked` | 409 |  |  | No deposit box is linked to the access. Gate: Refuses before sending (`409`). | Link a deposit box in Filarr. |
| `box_not_permanent` | 409 |  |  | The box linked to the access is not a permanent deposit box. Gate: Passes the refusal on. | Link a permanent box (Filarr creates one for you). |
| `box_not_found` | 404 |  |  | The linked deposit box no longer exists. Gate: Passes the refusal on. | Link another box in Filarr. |
| `deposit_not_found` | 404 |  |  | Filarr does not know this deposit. Gate: Status unknown. | Check the identifier. |
| `box_full` | 409 |  |  | Too many deposits wait to be filed in the box. Gate: Refuses before sending when it already knows; otherwise passes the refusal on. | Open Filarr to file them. |
| `box_storage_full` | 413 |  |  | The deposits waiting in the box take too much space. Gate: Passes the refusal on (`413`). | Open Filarr to file them. |
| `file_too_large` | 413 |  |  | The file is larger than Filarr accepts (`limit`). Gate: Refuses before sending when it knows the limit. | Send a smaller file. |
| `api_quota_files` | 429 | `wait` | yes | The account deposited as many files as its plan allows this month. Gate: Passes the refusal on with `Retry-After` (until the 1st, UTC). | Wait for the next month. |
| `api_quota_file_bytes` | 429 | `wait` | yes | The account deposited as many bytes of files as its plan allows this month. Gate: Passes the refusal on with `Retry-After`. | Wait for the next month. |
| `ext_status_conflict` | 409 |  |  | Two writers published a sync's state at the same time. Gate: Re-reads the revision and publishes again. | Nothing. |
| `ext_queue_conflict` | 409 |  |  | Two writers published a sync's conflict queue at the same time. Gate: Re-reads the revision and publishes again. | Nothing. |
| `ext_resolve_full` | 409 |  |  | Too many decisions wait for the sync's runner. | Make sure the gate that runs the sync is running; it reads the decisions at its next pass. |
| `extdb_lease_held` | 409 | `wait` | yes | Another process holds this sync's lease (two gates started with the same token). Gate: Skips the pass, state `waiting` (`extdb_lease_held`), retries later. | Run one gate per token; stop the other instance. |
| `extdb_relay_off` | 409 |  |  | Web only: Filarr's relay for external databases is switched off. | Run the sync from the desktop app or a gate. |

## States of an external sync

The gate publishes the state of each sync it runs (sealed: Filarr cannot read it; the members of the database can). These codes appear in that state, in the **Sources** screen and in `filarr-gate sources list`; never as an HTTP status. Codes marked "web only" concern syncs run by the Filarr web app.

| code | what happened | what to do |
|---|---|---|
| `extdb_key_missing` | The key of the external database is not given to the gate. | Give it: **Sources** screen, `filarr-gate sources key <id> --stdin`, `FILARR_GATE_EXTDB_<ID>`, or `gate.toml`. |
| `extdb_key_refused` | The external database refused the key (401 or 403). Nothing was deleted. | Create a new key with the rights the sync needs, and give it to the gate. |
| `extdb_unreachable` | The external database did not answer (or a TCP connector on a variant without TCP). | Check the host and the network from the gate's machine; PostgreSQL and MySQL need the Node or Docker gate. |
| `extdb_timeout` | The external database took too long. | Check its load; add an index on the key and on the change marker. |
| `extdb_tls` | The secure connection failed (certificate). | Fix the certificate, or choose `require` in Filarr; `off-local` only on a local network. |
| `extdb_not_found` | The table, sheet or database does not exist (or a `query` source was asked to write). | Check the names in the sync definition. |
| `extdb_upstream_limited` | The external service asks to slow down (429). | Nothing; the gate waits and the next pass resumes. |
| `extdb_too_large` | More than 100,000 rows read for one definition. | Narrow the source (a query, a view, a filter). |
| `extdb_schema_changed` | The source's columns changed: a choice waits in Filarr. | Open the database in Filarr and choose. |
| `extdb_quota_writes` | Filarr's writes of the day are used up; the changes wait until 00:00 UTC. Nothing is lost. | Nothing; or fewer passes. |
| `extdb_tier` | The plan has no scheduled sync (Solo and above). | A higher plan. |
| `extdb_unsigned` | The definition is not signed by the access creator (changed by someone else), or the creator's key is not authenticated. | The creator approves the change in Filarr; an access without a creator tag needs its token replaced. |
| `extdb_lease_held` | Another instance of this gate runs this sync. | Run one gate per token. |
| `extdb_guard` | Safety stop: too many rows would be marked or deleted at once. Nothing was written. | Check the source; to go on for this pass only, agree in Filarr or run `filarr-gate sources run <id> --ack-guard <pass>`. |
| `extdb_conflict_burst` | Too many new conflicts in one pass. Nothing was written. | Check the direction and the row key; on a first pass, settle it with `--initial source` or `--initial filarr`. |
| `extdb_def_newer` | The definition was written by a newer version of Filarr. | Update Filarr Gate. |
| `extdb_conflicts_pending` | The sync runs; some cells wait for a decision in the "ask me" queue. | Settle them in Filarr; the next pass applies the decisions. |
| `extdb_queue_full` | The "ask me" queue is full; new conflicts wait for room and their cells do not sync. | Settle conflicts in Filarr, or choose an automatic policy. |
| `extdb_policy_missing` | A two-way definition without a conflict policy (written by an older Filarr). Nothing runs. | Choose the policies in Filarr; it signs the definition again. |
| `extdb_def_invalid` | Gate only: the definition fails validation (the detail lists the codes, such as `host_mismatch`). | Fix the definition in Filarr. |
| `extdb_not_runner` | Gate only: a one-off import (`once`) is never run by a gate; it runs in the Filarr app. | Run the import from Filarr. |
| `extdb_relay_limited` | Web only: the relay's rate for external databases is used up. | Wait, or run the sync from the desktop app or a gate. |
| `extdb_web_unsupported` | Web only: this connector cannot be reached from a browser (PostgreSQL, MySQL). | Run the sync from the desktop app or a gate. |
